profile.headline: IC Manager, Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary: Skilled as a Full Stack developer with languages such as Java, Python, Go, and Angular 4.

positions.title: Principal Associate, Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed RESTful APIs in Java utilizing Spring Boot and Maven that were integrated within other batch processes to monitor their respective execution. 
• Implemented a purchased Angular 4 template to build a UI that utilized these same APIs to have a visual representation of the executions.
• Developed a Python framework scheduled to produce a flattened view of a standard Snowflake query to be used for Tableau consumption. 
• Converted SASS scripts to Snowflake SQL for scheduled execution of daily, weekly, monthly reports.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
• Consult with team members to develop a website that allows a user to submit, search, compare, and annotate RNA sequences; funded by the National Science Foundation
• Design an algorithm in Java to convert RNA sequences from BPSEQ format into a brand new format
• Compare a Naïve String Search algorithm against a Suffix Array Search algorithm to fortify the efficiency of our new RNA format
• Interface team member code and Varna using Spring MVC and tomcat to create a web application

positions.title: IT Student Intern
positions.description:
• Conducted Customer-Client meetings to address requirements and design specifications
• Updated an existing Visual Basic .NET application to the client’s new specifications
• Incorporated SQL scripts to create SQL backup files via the application
• Designed and developed both the front end and back end parts of the application
• Queried hundreds of tables in over 15 databases to access relevant pieces of data
• Followed SDLC methodologies to create detailed documentation of the application

publications.title: A New Structure Representation for RNA and Fast RNA Substructure Search
A Fast Algorithm for Finding Largest Common Substructures in Multiple RNAs
